Our Story

Hi, I'm Ahmad Hassan

Two years ago I started learning tailoring with one dream: to give men in Pakistan clothes that fit right and feel premium. Today I am a master tailor from Madina Town, Faisalabad.

I do two things: stitch your suits exactly your way, and sell genuine Kamalia winter khaddar, hand and machine woven, delivered free to your door.
